For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.
Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.

notes.note: Therefore indicates that in this verse John is giving the result of Jesus making the statement in 2:19. If it would be helpful in your language, you could express the meaning explicitly. Alternate translation: [Because Jesus said this about his body]

If your language does not use the passive form in this way, you could express the idea in active form or in another way that is natural in your language. If you must state who did the action, John implies that God did it. Alternate translation: [God raised him from the dead]
John is speaking about something that happened long after the event described in the previous verses. See the discussion of this in the introduction to this chapter.

notes.quote: τοῦτο & τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς
notes.note: Here, this and the word refer back to Jesus’ statement in 2:19. If this might confuse your readers, you could express the meaning explicitly. Alternate translation: [this statement about his body … the word about his body that Jesus had spoken]
John is speaking of the Scripture in general, not of one particular book within the Bible. Alternate translation, as in the UST: [the scriptures]

named.name: Jesus
named.brief: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

verses.text: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.

xrefs.text: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?
When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.
The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. What matters is faith expressing itself through love.
He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.

notes.quote: ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις
notes.note: Now here introduces a new event that happened some time after the events the story has just related. The story does not say how long after the previous events this new event happened. Use the natural form in your language for introducing a new event. Alternate translation: [Some time later in Jerusalem]

notes.quote: ἐν τῷ Πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ
notes.note: These two phrases could refer to: (1) two different parts of the festival, the Passover referring to the first day of the festival, and the festival referring to the Festival of Unleavened Bread that begins at Passover and was one week long. Alternate translation: [at the Passover, during the Festival of Unleavened Bread]; (2) the same event. Alternate translation: [at the Passover festival]
Here, name represents the person of Jesus. If this might confuse your readers, you could express the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [believed in him] or [trusted in him]

Here, seeing indicates the reason why the people were believing in Jesus. These people were only believing in Jesus because of the miracles he performed. If it would be helpful in your language, you could express the meaning explicitly. Alternate translation: [because they saw his signs]
See how you translated signs in 2:11. See also the discussion of signs in Part 3 of the General Introduction to the Gospel of John. Alternate translation: [significant miracles]

named.name: Jerusalem
named.brief: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

named.name: Passover
named.brief: An annual Jewish feast commemorating the Exodus

verses.text: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.

xrefs.text: However, there are some of you who do not believe. (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen

As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.

notes.note: Although many people were believing in him, Jesus knew that their belief was superficial and only lasted as long as he performed miracles for them. Therefore, he did not trust them the way he trusted his true disciples. Alternate translation: [did not trust them as true disciples] or [did not believe their belief in him]
Although the word men is masculine, John is using the word here in a generic sense that includes both men and women. Alternate translation: [he knew all people]

named.name: Jesus
named.brief: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

verses.text: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.

xrefs.text: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.
But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
However, there are some of you who do not believe. (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?

notes.quote: περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου & τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ
notes.note: Although both instances of the word man are masculine, John is using the word here in a generic sense that includes both men and women. Alternate translation: [about mankind … what was in mankind] or [about people … what was in people]

This refers to the inner thoughts and desires of people, which some cultures refer to as “the heart.” (See the discussion of this in the introduction to this chapter.) If this might confuse your readers, you could express the meaning explicitly. Alternate translation: [what people think] or [the thoughts and desires people have]
